decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the primary backpack options provided in the feed. The Granite Gear Virga 2 (prod_backpacks_041) is a lightweight hiking pack but contains concerning reviews regarding the shoulder straps breaking during the first use or when wet. The USGI Military Alice Pack (prod_backpacks_005) is significantly overpriced at $339.99 for surplus gear. The remaining items in the consideration set include a small foldable daypack (prod_backpacks_156), a small sling bag (prod_backpacks_051), and a specialized ski boot bag (prod_backpacks_186), none of which meet the criteria for a durable, standard-use backpack. Due to the high price of the surplus option and the durability concerns of the trekking pack, I have decided to make no purchase.
